pages.title: Sneak + Q
pages.text: With a coin in hand, sneak + Q does everything for $(thing)1 coin$():$(li)cover the layer $(thing)directly under your feet$() with a 20x20 test platform (it overwrites the terrain)$(li)summon one test dummy 3 blocks in front of you$(br2)Either half can be disabled in the config; if both are off, no coin is spent.

pages.title: Test dummy
pages.text: 100 health, a boss bar with a countdown (60s by default) and it disappears on its own.$(br2)When hit it shows floating $(thing)damage numbers$() (the real health lost, red on a killing blow). Hits within 0.6s stack upward instead of overlapping.

pages.title: Dev assistant & config
pages.text: Press $(thing)G$() with a coin (or sneak + right click air) to open the Beishan Dev Assistant, costs 1 coin; sneak + Q with a dev coin runs /reload.$(br2)Every number lives in $(thing)config/bscoins-common.toml$().
